rows.summary: Anand Rathi Wealth Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Board meeting held on October 13, 2025 has approved the following:1.Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) of the Company for the Second quarter and Half year ended 30th September, 2025; 2.Limited Review Report on unaudited financial results (standalone and consolidated) of the Company for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2025 3. Declared the first Interim dividend of Rs. 6.00 per Equity Share (120 % of face value of Rs. 5/- each) for the financial year 2025-264. Appointment of Company Secretary and Compliance officer 5. Incorporation of a subsidiary company in GIFT city Gandhi Nagar, Gujarat, subject to requisite approvals from Regulatory Authorities
